title: The Prayer for a Son and the Arrival of Kharak Singh

blocks.text: A Gursikh household invites five Gursikhs to pray because the couple longs to be blessed with a son, and the page sets their devotion against relatives who bring in a rival guide.
Those relatives arrive with Kharak Singh of the Gangu Shah sect and urge the householder to receive initiation from him instead of trusting the disciplined Khalsa way already honoured in the home.

The tension sharpens when ten armed Tat Khalsa initiated Singhs are present and the host refuses compromise, asking, How could he renege from Satguru’s Sikh ideology after already taking shelter in it?
